unit.why: An anecdote about R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev at the table of R. Barukh of Medzhybizh: in fervour he leaps onto the table and breaks all the glasses.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with a one-sentence stub about a Passover visit to the tsaddik of Kalov (a separate table set for him), too brief to count as its own story; it continues the series of numbered anecdotes about the Berdichever.

stories.start_quote: פ"א הי' אצל הרה״ק רבי ר' ברוך ממעזבוז
stories.end_quote: וערכו לו השלחן וסדר בפני עצמו
stories.summary_en: Visiting the fastidious R. Barukh of Medzhybizh, the Berdichever offers to sit across from him so his gestures will not disturb him; at the blessing over bread he is seized by fervour, leaps onto the table and smashes all the glasses and the bottle. A coda says that in Kalov at Passover a separate table was set for him.
